items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: I was talking to Willie Cook and Paul Gonzalves, people like that

ctx.x: to get a tenor player, so I got Pat Patrick. Pat had been working with Sun Ra. I knew him from Chicago -- and myself. So we went to Toronto and while there, (unintelligible) in the band come in, play with the Toronto Symphony. We all were staying at the King Edward Hotel there in Toronto. We were working at the Colonial Room and Duke loved to play, and Monk (unintelligible) from the hotel, he and his wife Nellie, Monk locked the door and you can't get to see him until it's time to go to work.

I understand Duke was knocking on Monk's door. "Hey, it's Duke." Monk wouldn't answer him. He said -- Duke wanted to play, you know. Duke was just jamming all the time, you know. That's his thing. However, I was talking to Willie Cook and Paul Gonzalves, people like that -- John Hodges -- I had met him, and I think Cat Anderson was in the band.
